cerez-politikasi.title: Cookie Policy
paragraphs: This draft is intended to provide general information about the essential cookies used on the G4 website.
Cookie preferences, cookie types, retention periods and third-party transfers will be added to this text with legal approval before the site goes live.

kvkk-aydinlatma-metni.title: KVKK Privacy Notice
paragraphs: This draft is not the final privacy notice regarding the processing of personal data shared in contact and quotation requests.
Data controller details, processing purposes, legal grounds, retention periods and application channels will be published after legal approval.
